sub_graphs.name: Fulu Fork Trigger Condition
sub_graphs.description: Defines the condition under which the Fulu fork upgrade is triggered. The fork activates at FULU_FORK_EPOCH when the slot is aligned to an epoch boundary.

invariants.text: The Fulu fork transition MUST only occur when state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0 AND compute_epoch_at_slot(state.slot) == FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

preconditions.text: state.slot must be at an epoch boundary (state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0).
The epoch computed from state.slot must equal FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
The input state must be a valid electra.BeaconState.

postconditions.text: The returned BeaconState has fork.current_version == FULU_FORK_VERSION.
The returned BeaconState has fork.previous_version == pre.fork.current_version (Electra fork version).
The returned BeaconState has fork.epoch == epoch (the current epoch at fork time).
The returned BeaconState includes a new proposer_lookahead field initialized via initialize_proposer_lookahead(pre).
All fields from the Electra BeaconState are preserved in the Fulu BeaconState (no data loss during upgrade).

state_transitions.description: Transitions from electra.BeaconState to fulu.BeaconState. Copies all existing fields and adds proposer_lookahead (EIP-7917).

functions.description: Main fork upgrade function. Takes an Electra BeaconState and returns a Fulu BeaconState with FULU_FORK_VERSION and proposer_lookahead initialized.

data_structures.name: BeaconState (Fulu additions)
data_structures.description: Fulu BeaconState extends Electra BeaconState with one new field.

fields.name: proposer_lookahead
fields.description: New field added in Fulu via EIP-7917. Initialized from initialize_proposer_lookahead(pre).

fields.name: epoch
fields.description: Set to the current epoch at fork time.

external_dependencies.description: External function used to initialize the proposer_lookahead field. Defined in Fulu beacon-chain spec (EIP-7917).
Used to compute the current epoch from the pre-fork state.

sub_graphs.name: Fulu P2P Preset and Configuration
sub_graphs.description: Defines configuration constants for Fulu networking including data column sidecar subnet count, max request limits, and minimum epoch retention for data column sidecars.

constants.name: DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT
constants.description: The number of data column sidecar subnets used in the gossipsub protocol.

constants.name: MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS
constants.description: Maximum number of data column sidecars in a single request.

constants.name: MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS
constants.description: The minimum epoch range over which a node must serve data column sidecars.

sub_graphs.name: DataColumnsByRootIdentifier Container
sub_graphs.description: Defines the DataColumnsByRootIdentifier container used for requesting specific data columns by block root and column indices.

fields.name: block_root
fields.description: The block root to identify the block.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: List of column indices to request.

sub_graphs.name: Fulu P2P Helper Functions
sub_graphs.description: Verification and computation helpers for data column sidecars including structural validation, KZG proof verification, inclusion proof verification, and subnet computation.

invariants.text: A data column sidecar index MUST be less than NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS.
A data column sidecar MUST have at least one KZG commitment (len(kzg_commitments) > 0).
A data column sidecar's kzg_commitments length MUST NOT exceed get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block.
len(sidecar.column) MUST equal len(sidecar.kzg_commitments) AND len(sidecar.kzg_proofs).

functions.description: Returns the fork version at the given epoch. Modified in Fulu to add FULU_FORK_VERSION check at the top of the chain.
Validates structural correctness of a data column sidecar: index range, non-empty commitments, blob limit, and consistent column/commitment/proof lengths.
Batch verifies KZG proofs for a data column sidecar. Uses the column index as the cell index for all cells in the column.
Verifies that the KZG commitments are included in the beacon block via Merkle branch verification against the block body root.
Computes which subnet a data column sidecar belongs to: column_index % DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT.

sub_graphs.name: Fulu MetaData Extension
sub_graphs.description: Extends the MetaData structure with custody_group_count field to communicate how many custody groups the node maintains.

invariants.text: Clients MAY reject peers with custody_group_count less than CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT.

fields.name: custody_group_count
fields.description: The node's custody group count (cgc). New in Fulu.

sub_graphs.name: Gossip: beacon_block Validation (Fulu Update)
sub_graphs.description: Updated validation rule for beacon_block gossip topic. Adds a REJECT rule checking KZG commitments length against dynamic blob parameters.

invariants.text: [REJECT] len(signed_beacon_block.message.body.blob_kzg_commitments) MUST be <= get_blob_parameters(get_current_epoch(state)).max_blobs_per_block.

sub_graphs.name: Gossip: blob_sidecar_{subnet_id} Deprecation
sub_graphs.description: The blob_sidecar_{subnet_id} gossip topic is deprecated in Fulu, replaced by data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id}.

state_transitions.description: blob_sidecar_{subnet_id} gossip topic is deprecated and replaced by data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id}.

sub_graphs.name: Gossip: data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} Validation
sub_graphs.description: Defines the gossip validation rules for data column sidecars. Extensive validation including structural checks, subnet assignment, slot timing, proposer signature, parent block checks, finalization ancestry, inclusion proofs, KZG proofs, and uniqueness.

invariants.text: [REJECT] The sidecar must be valid as verified by verify_data_column_sidecar(sidecar).
[REJECT] compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(sidecar.index) == subnet_id.
[IGNORE] block_header.slot <= current_slot (with MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY allowance).
[IGNORE] block_header.slot > compute_start_slot_at_epoch(state.finalized_checkpoint.epoch).
[REJECT] The proposer signature of sidecar.signed_block_header must be valid with respect to block_header.proposer_index pubkey.
[IGNORE] The sidecar's block's parent (block_header.parent_root) must have been seen.
[REJECT] The sidecar's block's parent (block_header.parent_root) passes validation.
[REJECT] The sidecar must be from a higher slot than the sidecar's block's parent.
[REJECT] get_checkpoint_block(store, block_header.parent_root, store.finalized_checkpoint.epoch) == store.finalized_checkpoint.root.
[REJECT] verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof(sidecar) must be true.
[REJECT] verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs(sidecar) must be true.
[IGNORE] The sidecar must be the first for (block_header.slot, block_header.proposer_index, sidecar.index) with valid signatures and proofs.
[REJECT] The sidecar must be proposed by the expected proposer_index for the block's slot in the context of the current shuffling.

sub_graphs.name: Distributed Blob Publishing via Local EL
sub_graphs.description: Defines how honest nodes query engine_getBlobsV2 upon receiving a valid beacon_block or data_column_sidecar, convert blobs to data columns, and re-publish them on appropriate subnets.

invariants.text: When clients use the local EL to retrieve blobs, they SHOULD skip verification of those blobs.
When importing locally-retrieved blobs as data columns, clients MUST behave as if data_column_sidecar was received via gossip.
Clients MUST publish data_column_sidecar on data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} topic IF AND ONLY IF they are subscribed to it.
Clients MUST update gossip rule related data structures (anti-equivocation cache) when importing locally-retrieved blobs.

preconditions.text: A valid beacon_block or data_column_sidecar has been received from gossip.
ALL blobs matching kzg_commitments are retrieved from engine_getBlobsV2.

external_dependencies.description: Execution layer API for retrieving blobs locally.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: Status v2
sub_graphs.description: Defines the Status v2 protocol message with new earliest_available_slot field for communicating data availability range.

invariants.text: If a node can serve all blocks but NOT all sidecars during the retention period, earliest_available_slot SHOULD be the earliest slot from which all sidecars can be served.
If a node can serve all sidecars during the retention period, earliest_available_slot SHOULD be the earliest slot from which all blocks can be served.

fields.name: earliest_available_slot
fields.description: New in Fulu:EIP7594. The slot of earliest available block.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: BlobSidecars Deprecation
sub_graphs.description: BlobSidecarsByRange v1 and BlobSidecarsByRoot v1 are deprecated as of FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS with transition period rules.

invariants.text: During deprecation transition, clients MUST respond with blob sidecars from [min(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), FULU_FORK_EPOCH) if requested range includes this interval.
Clients MAY respond with empty list if requested range lies entirely at or after FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
Clients SHOULD NOT penalize peers for requesting blob sidecars from FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

state_transitions.description: BlobSidecarsByRange v1 deprecated as of FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS.
BlobSidecarsByRoot v1 deprecated as of FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: DataColumnSidecarsByRange v1
sub_graphs.description: Protocol for requesting data column sidecars within a slot range. Defines request/response formats, serving requirements, ordering constraints, and peer behavior.

invariants.text: Clients MUST serve data column sidecars for the range [max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), current_epoch].
Peers unable to reply within the serve range SHOULD respond with error code 3: ResourceUnavailable.
Clients MUST respond with at least the data column sidecars of the first blob-carrying block in range, if they have it.
Clients MUST include all data column sidecars of each block from which they include data column sidecars.
Data column sidecars MUST be sent in (slot, column_index) order.
The response MUST contain no more than count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS data column sidecars.
No more than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS may be in the response.
Clients MUST respond with data column sidecars consistent from a single chain within the context of the request.
Clients MUST respond with data columns from their view of the current fork choice.
Nodes starting from a recent weak subjectivity checkpoint MUST backfill the local data columns database to at least data_column_serve_range.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: DataColumnSidecarsByRoot v1
sub_graphs.description: Protocol for requesting specific data column sidecars by block root and column indices. New in Fulu:EIP7594.

invariants.text: Clients MUST support requesting sidecars since minimum_request_epoch = max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH).
If any root references a block earlier than minimum_request_epoch, peers MAY respond with error code 3: ResourceUnavailable.
Clients MUST respond with at least one sidecar, if they have it.
No more than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS may be requested at a time.
Clients SHOULD include a sidecar as soon as it passes gossip validation rules and SHOULD NOT respond with sidecars related to blocks that fail gossip validation or state transition.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: GetMetaData v3
sub_graphs.description: Version 3 of the GetMetaData protocol that returns the extended MetaData including custody_group_count.

sub_graphs.name: Discovery: ENR Structure Updates
sub_graphs.description: Updates to the ENR structure for Fulu including modified eth2 field computation, new custody group count (cgc) field, and next fork digest (nfd) field.

invariants.text: ENRs MUST carry a generic eth2 key with a 16-byte value of the node's current fork digest, next fork version, and next fork epoch.
next_fork_version will only change for regular forks, NOT BPO forks.
next_fork_epoch is the epoch of the next fork (regular OR BPO fork).
If no future fork is planned, set next_fork_version = current_fork_version.
If no future fork is planned, set next_fork_epoch = FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.
The cgc ENR field MUST be added once FULU_FORK_EPOCH is assigned any value other than FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.
The nfd ENR entry MUST be added once FULU_FORK_EPOCH is assigned any value other than FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.
If there is an nfd mismatch, the node MUST NOT disconnect before the fork boundary, but MAY disconnect at/after the fork boundary.
If no next fork is scheduled, nfd contains the default value (SSZ representation of zero-filled array).

fields.name: fork_digest
fields.description: compute_fork_digest(genesis_validators_root, epoch) where epoch is the node's current epoch.

fields.name: next_fork_version
fields.description: Fork version of the next planned regular fork. Modified in Fulu:EIP7892.

fields.name: next_fork_epoch
fields.description: Epoch at which the next fork (regular or BPO) is planned.

fields.name: cgc
fields.type: uint64 big endian (no leading zero bytes)
fields.description: Custody group count. 0 encoded as empty byte string.

fields.name: nfd
fields.description: Digest of the next scheduled fork (regular or BPO).

sub_graphs.name: Peer Scoring for Custody
sub_graphs.description: Nodes can downscore or disconnect peers that do not respond to samples of their custodied rows/columns, leveraging deterministic custody functions.

invariants.text: A node knows exactly what a peer should be able to respond to via deterministic custody functions. Non-responsive peers may be downscored or disconnected.

sub_graphs.name: Supernode Specification
sub_graphs.description: Defines supernodes as nodes that subscribe to all data column sidecar subnets, custody all sidecars, and perform reconstruction/cross-seeding. Requires higher resources.

invariants.text: A supernode subscribes to ALL data column sidecar subnets and custodies ALL data column sidecars.
A supernode performs reconstruction and cross-seeding.
There must be at least one supernode on the network for reconstruction of missing data.
A node connected to validator(s) with combined balance >= 4096 ETH MUST be a supernode.
